work_package.blocker: The callable-only matrix excludes named noncallable declaration and macro visibility, while the source-form matrix conflates missing identities with differing source spellings.

work_package.negative_scope: This matrix derives compiler-visible named declaration and macro identity only. It does not compare declaration forms, macro replacements, record byte layouts, archive extraction, selected callable implementation, runtime behavior, installed sysroot closure, family promotion, or public x86 support.
